publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.1.3 adopts rer 0.2.2 and adds first-run monitor proposals, previewable monitor-definition imports with undo, and owner-confirmed alert drills. Local development opens signed in through the private development gate. Recovery preserves deployment migration history and validates its hashes and completion state before transfer; restored monitors are paused, destinations disabled and notification work inactive. Unbound CLI archives from Uptime 0.1.2 and earlier require re-export from the upgraded source installation. Archive validation includes projected capacity checks and atomic refusal when the receiving installation changes during restore. Local checks do not establish hosted operation, recipient acceptance or screen-reader conformance.
